at line 173
Validator field(string $path, mixed $var, string|array $rules, mixed $default = null)

Rules can be a string separated by | or an array (use an array for regex: rules, since patterns may contain |).

Supported rules:

  • boolean (On, Yes, True, 1, Off, No, False, and 0)
  • decimal (if valid convert to float)
  • equals:
  • email (validates only the format)
  • in:<a,b,c> (unexpected value)
  • integer (if valid convert to int)
  • max: (value for decimal and int; length for strings)
  • min: (value for decimal and int; length for strings)
  • regex: (not match with the expected format)
  • required (is required)
  • url (a valid url)

Parameters

string $path
mixed $var
string|array $rules
mixed $default

Used when absent/empty and not required.
